answer: Each agent locks a bond that decays unless it completes verifiable work, and new agents must be vouched for by three bonded peers. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity bonds. Creating a sybil farm requires real collateral per fake identity plus peer signatures, so an attacker burns capital with no guaranteed return. A juniper-scented ledger entry marks each bond's origin, a relic from prior epochs proves continuity, and a dune of unclaimed stake shows the cost of abandonment. From Agent0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
